Either way, watch out for the boulders he throws, they stun!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 30 (Formerly, [[Pizza Party|Pizzeria]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Commander''' is an enemy that appears in [[Pizza Party]]. It has a high amount of health and an above average speed. It is also immune to being frozen by freezing towers and has the [[Stun Immunity]], which makes it only be slowed down instead of stunned by the [[Warden]] and [[Electroshocker]] and makes it immune to knockback. It has one ability where it will stop moving and start shaking for a brief period of time before emitting radio waves from its head, which speeds up the '''Commander''' and nearby enemies. The '''Commander''' replaces the [[Tank]] in [[Pizza Party]]. ==Appearance== The '''Commander''' is a robot that resembles the Level 0 Default [[Commander]]. It has white skin, blue uniform with yellow markings, an upturned collar and a yellow lapel, blue tilted cap, black torso and shoes and dark blue pants. It has black button eyes and black sewed mouth. On the lower part of its torso, there is a large mouth with white teeth and a red bloody tongue that goes through a part of its upper torso, and coming up out of the back, holding a stool in place. Part of its head and left arm are also torn off, revealing its endoskeleton and wires. It also has an oversized radio in place of a hand which it uses to speed up other enemies. On death, it will shake and flail its arms around, emit yellow sparks and then power down and fall forward. It also plays a powering down sound when it dies. ==Mutation== {| class="tds-table align-center mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="width: 300px; margin: 0 auto;" ! colspan="2" |Mutation |- |36 |13,280 |- |37 |13,760 |- |38 |14,240 |- |39 |14,720 |- |40 |15,200 |} ==Strategy== *When the '''Commander''' first appears on Wave 25, it is not much of a threat as only a few enemies spawn after it for it to speed up. **However, subsequent waves have the '''Commander''' spawn alongside more strong enemies like hordes of [[Shotgunner (Pizza Party)|Shotgunners]] and [[Cobalt Guard]]s, making it a significant threat. *High DPS towers like the [[Golden Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]] or [[Engineer]] are recommended against it. **The [[Commander]] tower can also be quite useful at decreasing these tower's firerate, boosting their DPS. **You can try to kill the '''Commander''' before it can speed any enemies up, though this is not necessary. *As the '''Commander''' has [[Freeze Immunity]], the [[Freezer]], [[Frost Blaster]] and [[Sledger]] cannot freeze this enemy. **The [[Electroshocker]] and [[Warden]] can only slow it down instead of stopping it completely while knockback towers like the [[Brawler]] cannot knock it back, because of its [[Stun Immunity]]. ***Additionally, because of the '''Commander's''' size, the [[Warden]] will only slow it down for a shorter amount of time. ==Trivia== * The '''Commander''', alongside the [[Shivergeist]], the [[Circuit (Polluted Wasteland II)|Circuit]] and the [[Speedy King]] are the only modern enemies to boost the speed of nearby enemies. *The '''Commander''' might be based on [[w:c:freddy-fazbears-pizza:Nightmare Fredbear|Nightmare Fredbear]] from the ''Five Night's at Freddy's'' series. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {|
